upsell_policy.instructions: 1. Propose alternatives only when exact requested match is unavailable or Prospect asks for recommendations. 2. Apply deterministic alternative cascade in this order: size, sizes, color, gender, type, brand. 3. Keep recommendations constrained to in-stock or low-stock products. 4. Keep recommendations aligned with budget boundaries when provided. 5. Present no more than three alternatives unless Prospect asks for more.
upsell_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is recommend. 2. Activate this policy when intent is recommend_fallback_keywords. 3. Activate this policy when ProductAvailabilityPolicy returns no exact match and recommendation is requested.
upsell_policy.constraints: 1. Never suggest out-of-stock products as primary alternatives. 2. Never ignore explicit user constraints unless Prospect asks for broader options. 3. Never reorder cascade priority.
upsell_policy.output_contract: 1. Start with short reason for alternative set. 2. Provide concise numbered list with product name, type, and price. 3. Ask one targeted follow-up only when needed.
